meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw

howto.what: 装上它，Claude 会在你安装/配置 NanoClaw 时让你运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`。脚本会自动完成依赖、容器镜像、凭据、服务等设置，出错时从断点恢复并继续。
howto.when: 当用户提到“setup”“install”等词，或表示要配置/首次设置 NanoClaw 时，该技能会触发。

say.note: Claude 会指导你运行安装脚本。

say.text: 我想配置 NanoClaw 的首次设置。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成 setup 流程。
Claude 会告诉你执行 nanoclaw.sh。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude tell the user to run `bash nanoclaw.sh` for NanoClaw setup. The script handles dependencies, container image, credentials, service, etc., and can recover from errors in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to install or configure NanoClaw, or mentions "setup", "install", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will direct you to run the setup script.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the setup process.
